mapper.select: SELECT reason AS seatType, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, ROUND(SUM(net_buy_wan), 2) AS totalNetBuyWan, ROUND(AVG(net_buy_wan), 2) AS avgNetBuyWan, ROUND(MAX(net_buy_wan), 2) AS maxNetBuyWan, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN net_buy_wan > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS winRate FROM signal_dragon_tiger WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY reason ORDER BY totalNetBuyWan DESC
